logp.method_description: Equal volumes (20 mL) of n-octanol and water were mixed with intense stirring (1400rpm) for 24 h, followed by separating into two layers. Moderate amount of each compound was added to 2 mL of the separated n-octanol, the maximal UV-vis absorbance was recorded (Ainit.). The 2 mL of n-octanol solution was mixed with 2 mLof the separated water through intense stirring for additional 24 h to equilibrate. After separation, the maximal UV-vis absorbance of n-octanol phase was recorded (Aend.).The log P values were calculated by using equation log P = log(Aend./(Ainit.- Aend.)).
